introduction.text: Castello Barberini is a 17th‑century castle in Piazza del castello Barberini, San Vittorino, Rome, built on 12th‑century foundations, notable for its Baroque architecture and the Barberini family emblem.

history.description: The castle was built on 12th‑century foundations.
The castle was constructed in the 17th century.

design.description: The castle features a square tower, merlature, tufa walls, and the Barberini coat of arms.
